description.text: Special education teaching assistants help preschool and primary and secondary students with learning, emotional, or physical disabilities learn academic, social, and life skills, provide material, assistive device, and activity support, preserve objective observations, and report to teachers. The teacher holds main responsibility for designing and delivering the education plan and services; specific plan implementation must be under the supervision of special education teachers or psychology or speech-language pathology professionals and is not the same as independent assistant diagnosis or therapy design. This page freezes 25-9043.00 and excludes regular and postsecondary assistants; the BLS wage and projection figures are only a 25-9045 non-postsecondary combined reference and cannot be split into precise special assistant data. China's actual teaching qualifications, specialized training, entry inquiry, protection, and data use are checked separately, and special education teacher allowances do not automatically apply to all assistants. Entirely fictional paper observation and classification only checks rule original values and unknowns and does not prove real intervention effects, nor does it grant readers contact with students, physical care, or class teaching authority.
